entries.text: Release 0.1.0 lays the foundation: MIT license, editorconfig, gitattributes, gitignore, markdownlint config, AGENTS.md hard rules with the skill-file format standard and verification protocol, and the README two-skill model over the 36-component Tier-0 kit.

Release 0.2.0 ships Registry v2 with the catalog schema, generator, verifier, and per-kind JSONL sidecars, the generated catalog.json mirror, the overlaps relations, the formatting kind with twelve design-system documents, twelve verified install commands including context7 and firecrawl-mcp, the Vanguard and Doctrine skills, the arsenal plugin, the role agents, worktree orchestration, and kit/kit.lock with 36 pinned Tier-0 entries.

Release 0.3.0 adds the cli kind place with zero entries, the vantrilex-prime orientation skill, the task-dispatcher seventh hook on the user-message boundary with its five scenarios, the Arabic README counterpart, the AI_GUIDE operating manual, five role agents as real OpenCode definitions, and the catalog fallback, validation, hygiene, and binding-gap rules in Vanguard.

Release 0.4.0 adds the fourth top-level skill vantrilex-workflow-forge, the AGENT.md living-state template with six fixed sections, 64 sandbox-verified CLI entries, the BLAZAR primary agent with default_agent blazar companion config, unifies the machine on OpenCode V2, proves the plugin on the V2 surface, and moves the lock to 112 with the catalog at 2804 while closing red-team findings F1, F3, F4, F5, F7, and F8 with F2 and F6 recorded as deliberate.

Release 0.4.1 routes shell file-write redirection through the docs-discipline guard verdict path, pairs guard verdicts per path on multi-file calls, sanitizes session ids before path construction, fixes UNC root resolution with V1 and V2 kill-switch parity, removes the BLAZAR model pin per the DEFAULT-ONLY law, and reviews the github MCP pin unchanged; git tags v0.1.0 through v0.4.1 exist in the repository.
